owner_creation.analysis: The pasting exported lbool records bracketed-paste suppression state; cmd_edit sets it for a paste-start action when no_paste is enabled.
owner_creation.invariant: Paste suppression owns no clipboard or command bytes.

aliases_escapes.analysis: command.rs:1239 reads pasting and command.rs:1744 clears it for a new command; its Boolean value carries no input-source identity.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Paste state is not an owning token for a byte stream.

callback_targets.analysis: A paste-end action calls stop_ignoring_input directly; the pasting mode stores neither that function address nor a retained callback context.
callback_targets.invariant: Paste termination dispatch has a fixed direct target.

invalidation.analysis: The command loop resets pasting separately from command text and other mode flags; stale mode state must not be reused for a different command input.
invalidation.invariant: New-command setup must retire prior paste interpretation.

mutation_commit.analysis: The pasting mode change and any discarded input occur in different functions; no owned event binds the bracket marker, command buffer and suppression decision.
mutation_commit.invariant: Paste state is not an atomic editor-state transition.

release_pair.analysis: Clearing the pasting flag releases no source FD, clipboard storage or command buffer; those have separate owners and lifetimes.
release_pair.invariant: Ending paste suppression does not release input ownership.

error_cleanup.analysis: A Boolean cannot report truncated input, absent end markers or underlying read errors; pasting must not be treated as an I/O completion receipt.
error_cleanup.invariant: Paste mode conveys policy rather than read success.

signals_handoff.analysis: pasting crosses command/editor boundaries without an input-generation identity or exclusive owner, so a new command must explicitly retire prior suppression state.
signals_handoff.invariant: Suppression-state coupling remains a raw-core constraint.
limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.
